treatments.title: Treatments

teethWhitening.title: Teeth Whitening
teethWhitening.description: Professional whitening treatment for a brighter, more confident smile in just one visit.
teethWhitening.fullDescription: Our advanced teeth whitening treatment uses professional-grade materials to safely lighten your teeth by several shades. The procedure is quick, comfortable, and delivers immediate results that can last for years with proper care.

invisibleAligners.title: Invisible Aligners
invisibleAligners.description: Straighten your teeth discreetly with custom-made clear aligners. Comfortable and virtually invisible.
invisibleAligners.fullDescription: Our invisible aligners offer a modern alternative to traditional braces. Custom-made for your teeth, these clear aligners gradually shift your teeth into the desired position without the discomfort or appearance of metal braces.

dentalImplants.title: Dental Implants
dentalImplants.description: Permanent, natural-looking tooth replacement solution that looks and functions like your natural teeth.
dentalImplants.fullDescription: Dental implants are the gold standard for replacing missing teeth. They consist of a titanium post surgically placed in your jawbone, topped with a natural-looking crown. Implants preserve bone structure and provide a permanent solution.

teethCleaning.title: Teeth Cleaning
teethCleaning.description: Professional deep cleaning to remove plaque, tartar, and stains for optimal oral health.
teethCleaning.fullDescription: Regular professional teeth cleaning is essential for maintaining healthy teeth and gums. Our dental hygienists use advanced techniques to remove plaque and tartar buildup, polish your teeth, and provide personalized oral hygiene guidance.

rootCanal.title: Root Canal Therapy
rootCanal.description: Save your natural tooth with gentle, pain-free root canal treatment using modern techniques.
rootCanal.fullDescription: Root canal therapy removes infected or damaged pulp from inside your tooth, saving it from extraction. With modern anesthesia and techniques, the procedure is comfortable and highly successful.

cosmetic.title: Cosmetic Dentistry
cosmetic.description: Transform your smile with veneers, bonding, and other aesthetic dental procedures.
cosmetic.fullDescription: Our cosmetic dentistry services enhance the appearance of your smile. From porcelain veneers to tooth bonding and gum contouring, we offer comprehensive solutions tailored to your aesthetic goals.
